description:
The semantic rule engine: business rules written over semantic paths rather than over
    the XPath of a syntax, so that one rule serves a UBL invoice, a CII invoice and a
    document that was never XML alike. A rule is declarative JSON over a closed operator
    set, or a Java class where the language does not reach; both kinds live in one rule
    pack and produce the same findings. The findings are a layer of their own and are
    never presented as conformance to the ESJ format.
